capability.summary: User explicitly requests song-level key/mode, instrument-aware synth generation with isolated audition and Scale Lock nearest-note snapping (ties down), plus optional Follow Playhead default off. Product request overrides default GA-only scope.

controls.description: Song-level root, mode and shared chord progression, portable and undoable.
controls.test: Theory arithmetic, progression compatibility, persistence and invalid-input atomicity.

controls.description: Deterministic bass, melody, chords and arpeggio generators with sparse/driving/syncopated/answer styles, protection and isolated preview.
controls.test: Pitch/chord/rhythm invariants, musical repetition/cadence, reproducibility, role limits, audition/apply/undo and stale previews.

controls.description: Manual edits and MIDI snap to the closest allowed pitch; ties choose the lower pitch.
controls.test: Every root/mode, editing and octave-boundary cases; sound/export agreement and old-song compatibility.

controls.description: Optional view preference follows the audible phrase, default off, without changing notes or scheduling.
controls.test: Device-time boundaries, start/stop, manual navigation, editing gestures and persistence of preference.
